scene_1_arrival_at_the_loom_house.speaker: Manang Loleng
scene_1_arrival_at_the_loom_house.text: Naabi abi gid namon inyong pag abot it atong mga bisita. Maliya ag tanawon ro among mga ginhabi .
scene_1_arrival_at_the_loom_house.translation: Welcome, visitors. Here, look at our weaving.

scene_1_arrival_at_the_loom_house.speaker: Player
scene_1_arrival_at_the_loom_house.text: Whoa. Amazing, Grandma — I mean, Anang. Sorry, it’s my first time seeing a loom like this.

scene_1_arrival_at_the_loom_house.speaker: Anang Loleng
scene_1_arrival_at_the_loom_house.text: Uwat kaso. Abo man nga bisita ro nangangawa iya .
scene_1_arrival_at_the_loom_house.translation: It’s alright. Many visitors are surprised here too.

scene_1_arrival_at_the_loom_house.speaker: Rose
scene_1_arrival_at_the_loom_house.text: This whole community weaves piña cloth. Been doing it for generations — older than any of us.

scene_1_arrival_at_the_loom_house.speaker: Anang Loleng
scene_1_arrival_at_the_loom_house.text: Halin ra sa katamnan — sa tanum nga piña. . Kaabo nga ueubrahon bago mahimo nga eambong
scene_1_arrival_at_the_loom_house.translation: This comes from the farm — from the piña plant. A lot of work before it becomes cloth.

choices.label: This is beautiful work, Anang. I’d love to learn more.
It’s really intricate, kind of hard to understand all at once.
This looks like it takes forever, isn’t a machine faster?

scene_1_arrival_at_the_loom_house.speaker: Anang Loleng
scene_1_arrival_at_the_loom_house.text: Saeamat, apo. Not many young ones say that anymore.

scene_1_arrival_at_the_loom_house.speaker: Anang Loleng
scene_1_arrival_at_the_loom_house.text: Step by step. Even I took years.

scene_1_arrival_at_the_loom_house.speaker: Anang Loleng
scene_1_arrival_at_the_loom_house.text: Machines can’t feel the thread the way a hand does. That’s the difference.

scene_1_arrival_at_the_loom_house.speaker: Anang Loleng
scene_1_arrival_at_the_loom_house.text: Gusto mo ubrahon? iya, sunod ka kakon
scene_1_arrival_at_the_loom_house.translation: Do you want to try? Here, follow me.

scene_2_trying_the_loom.speaker: Rose
scene_2_trying_the_loom.text: Oh, this I have to see. Balikbayan versus loom. Place your bets.

scene_2_trying_the_loom.speaker: Player
scene_2_trying_the_loom.text: Gee, thanks for the confidence, Rose.

scene_2_trying_the_loom.speaker: Anang Loleng
scene_2_trying_the_loom.translation: Slowly. This isn’t about whose faster.

scene_2_trying_the_loom.text: Will you try weaving on your own?

choices.label: I’ll take it slow, Anang. Show me the first move again.
Can you guide my hands through it first?
Maybe I’ll just watch, this looks too hard for me.

scene_2_trying_the_loom.speaker: Anang Loleng
scene_2_trying_the_loom.text: That’s the spirit, apo. One thread at a time.

scene_2_trying_the_loom.speaker: Rose
scene_2_trying_the_loom.text: Come on, at least try one row. I’ll laugh either way, might as well earn it.

scene_2_trying_the_loom.speaker: Anang Loleng
scene_2_trying_the_loom.text: Ay, mayad  gid, apo! Para sa una nga ubra, bukon man maeain!
scene_2_trying_the_loom.translation: Oh, that’s good, grandchild! For your first time, not bad at all!

scene_3_closing_gift.speaker: Anang Loleng
scene_3_closing_gift.text: Hara, batuna, tanda halin sa amon nga komunidad.
scene_3_closing_gift.translation: Here, take this. A token from our community.

scene_3_closing_gift.speaker: Player
scene_3_closing_gift.text: Saeamat gid,  Anang. I’ll keep this.

scene_3_closing_gift.speaker: Anang Loleng
scene_3_closing_gift.text: mag dahan ka sa imong pagbiyahe. ag magbalik ka iya, ha, kung may tyempo ka.
scene_3_closing_gift.translation: Take care on your journey. And come back here, okay, if you have time.

scene_3_closing_gift.speaker: Rose
scene_3_closing_gift.text: Not bad for your first field trip, balikbayan. Two down, more to go.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_verbs_.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_verbs_.text: Tan-awa sanda. panaw — to walk... wait, save that one. Bangon — to get up, like when you fall.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_verbs_.speaker: Player
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_verbs_.text: These make sense with the actions right in front of us.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_verbs_.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_verbs_.text: That’s the point. agto iya— come here. agto idto — go there. Dayon — then, or “continue.”

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_verbs_.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_verbs_.text: Bakae — to buy. Baligya — to sell. Tan-aw — to look, to see. Hambae — to speak. Sabát — to answer.
Will you try using the new words?

choices.label: I’ll try — “Gusto ko mag bakae,” I want to buy? Something like that?
I get the meanings, but it’s still hard to use them correctly.
There are too many verbs now, I’m losing track.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_verbs_.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_verbs_.text: Close enough! You’re building sentences now, not just words.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_verbs_.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_verbs_.text: That’s normal. Meaning first, grammar later.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_verbs_.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_verbs_.text: Deep breath. We’ll circle back to these. No rush.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_verbs_.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_verbs_.text: Taas — tall, or long. Naba — short. Paspas — fast. Hinay — slow, base word of “hinay-hinay” that Anang taught you.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_verbs_.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_verbs_.text: Bug-at — heavy. Maugan — light, not bug-at.  — small words, but you’ll need them everywhere.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_verbs_.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_verbs_.text: Kuntra naman — “against.” Rarely used, but good to know.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_verbs_.speaker: Player
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_verbs_.text: My head’s kind of full now, but I think I actually get most of it.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_verbs_.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_verbs_.text: That’s the goal. Not perfect. Just moving forward.

idle_pool_manang_loleng.speaker: Manang Loleng
idle_pool_manang_loleng.text: Ang akon lola, siya nagtudlo sa akon sang hablon. Pareho man sa imo, apo, tudlo halin sa lola.
Hinahaplos ni Manang Loleng ang tela, para bang bawat hibla ay may kwento.

idle_pool_manang_loleng.speaker: Manang Loleng
idle_pool_manang_loleng.text: Halong sa hilo, apo — mabilis magbuhi kung indi tama ang hawak. [NEW-VERIFY: "mabilis magbuhi" - loose thread phrase]

idle_pool_manang_loleng.speaker: Manang Loleng
idle_pool_manang_loleng.text: Damo turista nagalabay diri, pero gadiit lang tumindog. Ikaw, lain — nagpabilin ka.
idle_pool_manang_loleng.translation: Many tourists pass by here, but just stand and look. You're different — you stayed.

idle_pool_manang_loleng.text: Napailing si Manang Loleng, natutuwa habang tinitingnan ang unang linya ng weaving ni Player.

idle_pool_manang_loleng.speaker: Manang Loleng
idle_pool_manang_loleng.text: Kung mabudlay man, indi lang pag-untat. Amo na 'na ang leksyon sang hablon — kag sang kabuhi.

idle_pool_manang_loleng.speaker: Manang Loleng
idle_pool_manang_loleng.text: Ipabaton ko sa imo Lola Jonabel ni. Siguro madumduman niya ang iya lola man.

idle_pool_manang_loleng.speaker: Manang Loleng
idle_pool_manang_loleng.text: Sa uma pa lang, damo trabaho na. Diri lang nagatapos ang una nga parte.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Wag mo akong tignan nang ganyan, hindi ako tour guide. ...okay, konti lang.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Magtuon ka gid, ha. Indi lang basta-basta.
Tumingin si Rose sa Player nang matagal, parang sinusukat kung seryoso ba talaga siya.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: My Lola Susan talks about your Lola Jonabel parang superhero pa. Big shoes to fill, balikbayan.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Fine, you're not completely hopeless. ...don't let that get to your head.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Alam mo, hindi ko rin naman gustong magturo dati. Pero, sige na nga.
Napailing si Rose, pero halatang pigil ang ngiti.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Wag kang mag-expect ng slack sa 'kin kasi pinsan ka daw ni Tita Susan. Rules apply to everyone.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Stop overthinking the pronunciation. Just say it. Worst case, I laugh at you.
Tumingin si Rose sa mapa, tapos kay Player, parang sinusukat ang route.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Manong Pedring likes you. That's rare — he's picky about balikbayans.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Magbulig ako sa imo, pero indi ako mangin madali. Deal pa rin 'yun.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: You're actually trying. Didn't expect that, not gonna lie.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: I actually like it here. Don't tell Manang Loleng I said that, she'll never let me hear the end of it.
Tinitignan ni Rose ang unang linya ng weaving ni Player, tapos tumango, medyo impressed.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: You're better at this than the greeting stuff, honestly. Weird flex, but okay.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Magtuon ka pa sang isara ka leksyon, tapos indi ka na "balikbayan" sa akon. Promise.

idle_pool_lola_jonabel.text: Kadugay ko na di nakatilaw sang kan-on nga tumbien sa balay ni Susan.

idle_pool_lola_jonabel.speaker: Lola Jonabel
idle_pool_lola_jonabel.text: Player, do not forget to write to your Lola back home too. Distance should never mean silence.
Napahiling si Lola Jonabel sa bintana, nakangiti nang walang partikular na dahilan.

idle_pool_lola_jonabel.speaker: Lola Jonabel
idle_pool_lola_jonabel.text: Kung pagod ka na, Apo, sabihin mo lang. Hindi kailangan lahat ngayon din matutunan.

idle_pool_lola_jonabel.speaker: Lola Jonabel
idle_pool_lola_jonabel.text: This town raised me before it raised your Tita Susan. Funny how it still feels the same.
Hinihipo ni Lola Jonabel ang lumang litrato sa kanyang bag, hindi napapansin na napapangiti siya.

idle_pool_lola_jonabel.speaker: Lola Jonabel
idle_pool_lola_jonabel.text: Marami pang lugar dito na gusto kong ipakita sa'yo, Apo. Isa-isa lang.

idle_pool_lola_jonabel.speaker: Lola Jonabel
idle_pool_lola_jonabel.text: Alam mo, kahit gaano man katagal, parang kailan lang 'yong huling beses ko dito.
Hinawakan ni Lola Jonabel ang piña cloth nang matagal, tila naaalala ang sarili niyang lola.

idle_pool_lola_jonabel.speaker: Lola Jonabel
idle_pool_lola_jonabel.text: My own lola wove like this too, Apo. Small world, isn't it — some things never change here.

idle_pool_lola_jonabel.speaker: Lola Jonabel
idle_pool_lola_jonabel.text: Ingatan mo 'yang bookmark. It's not just cloth, it's somebody's years of patience.
